scope_statement: CRT-632 ensures that we support FX_SPOT instrument type in specific Adaptive widgets: "Search", "Watchlist", and "Instrument".
checklist_notes:
Good: 
  - division by widget
  - division by individual "rules subsets" that define general function
  - further division into atomic checks for each rules subset
  - negative and positive scenarios, edge cases
  - links to design docs
  - no out of scope items, related checks exist but they are strictly tied to the scope of the epic
  
  Mixed:
  - inclusion of "omitted" items - not strictly necessary in a checklist
reference_checklist:
## 1. Search Widget
### **Search Rules**
- FX_SPOT instruments are searchable by symbol.
>https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1768-14179&t=LLodB9AW7sJZUtP7-4
- FX_SPOT instruments are searchable by description with no whitespaces.
- FX_SPOT instruments are searchable by description with whitespaces.
- Search triggers with a minimum of 1 character and is case-insensitive.
- FX_SPOT instruments are searchable with the 'All' instrument type tab selected.
- Searching by ISIN returns no results for FX_SPOT.
### **Instrument Type Filter ('FX Spot' tab)**
- 'FX Spot' tab is present in the instrument type filter.
- 'FX Spot' tab can be selected alone.
- 'FX Spot' tab can be selected simultaneously with other tabs (except 'ALL').
- 'FX Spot' tab is visible even if no FX_SPOT instruments are available for the selected account.
- Filter applies correctly before typing a search query.
- Filter applies correctly after typing a search query.
### **OPOL ("Excahnge") Filter**
- OPOL ("Exchange") filter is visible on search even if list returns only FX_SPOT instruments.
- OPOL ("Exchange") filter dropdown displays options for the filtered range based on the available values.
- OPOL ("Exchange") filter allows multi-select with correct sorting.
>In instrument settings OPOL parameter is optional. However, when set it creates a dynamic value in the Exchange filter in the Adaptive UI. This change is not applied on-the-fly, only on page refresh (F5).
- Check that OPOL ("Exchange") filter is greyed out if filtered FX_SPOT doesn't have an OPOL assigned.
>This check is not strictly speaking part of this epic but we can verify it for FX_SPOT specifically just in case.
- Selecting OPOL filter value(s) shows FX_SPOT instruments only related to that value and vice versa.
### **Currency Filter**
- Currency filter is visible on search even if list returns only FX_SPOT instruments.
- Currency filter allows multi-select with correct sorting.
- Selecting Currency filter value(s) shows FX_SPOT instruments only related to that value and vice versa.
### **Filters common logic**
- Combinations of filters (OPOL + Currency) produce the correct intersection for FX_SPOT instruments.
- Switching the instrument type tab to FX Spot resets OPOL and Currency filters to "All" if some combination was used.
- Applying OPOL filter does not reset the selected instrument type tab when "FX Spot" is selected.
- Applying Currency filter does not reset the selected instrument type tab when "FX Spot" is selected.
### **Search Result Card (FX_SPOT)**
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the instrument description.
>Check if the text can fit 2 lines.
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the logo.
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the instrument symbol.
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the instrument type label.
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the instrument currency.
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the instrument type logo.
>For now we use 2 first letters of the description. Thread: https://devexperts.slack.com/archives/C08C65HS069/p1749718994161279?thread_ts=1749713295.776949&cid=C08C65HS069
- FX_SPOT search result card displays the market state indicator (colored dot).
- FX_SPOT search result card does NOT display the OPOL acronym.
- FX_SPOT search result card does NOT display the country flag.
- FX_SPOT search result card market state indicator reflects the correct open/closed state based on the instrument schedule.
- FX_SPOT search result card provides an 'Add to watchlist' action.
>"Star" icon is actionable.
- FX_SPOT search result card provides a 'Remove from watchlist' action.
- Tapping the FX_SPOT search result card navigates to the Instrument page.
- Search results show only FX_SPOT instruments fully available for trading on the user's accounts.
- Search results show a truncation message if more than 30 FX_SPOT results exist.
## 2. Recently Viewed Widget
- FX_SPOT instrument appears in the 'Recently Viewed' list after visiting its Instrument page.
- FX_SPOT instrument card follows rearrangement logic from the main functionality.
>Whichever card is clicked last, is placed to the top of the recently viewed list.
- FX_SPOT card in Recently Viewed displays the correct instrument information.
- Disabled FX_SPOT instrument card is translucent in Recently Viewed.
- FX_SPOT instrument card persists in Recently Viewed after page refresh if the instrument is disabled.
- Clicking a disabled FX_SPOT instrument card opens the Instrument page with an "Instrument data is not available" notification.
## 3. Watchlist Widget
- Added FX_SPOT instruments are visible in the watchlist.
>https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1761-40258&t=V33jnZhjHc5Zmg66-0
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the instrument description with logo.
>For now we use 2 first letters of the description. Thread: https://devexperts.slack.com/archives/C08C65HS069/p1749718994161279?thread_ts=1749713295.776949&cid=C08C65HS069
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the instrument symbol.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the mark price at instrument precision.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the mark price with correct data from WebSocket.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the day price change percentage with coloring
- Coloring uses green for positive and 0 change for FX_SPOT instruments.
- Coloring uses red for negative change for FX_SPOT instruments.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the day price change percentage correctly, calculated according to the formula.
>((Last Price - Previous Day Close Price) / Previous Day Close Price) * 100%, rounded to 2 decimals mathematically
- Price change percentage is signed - for negative change.
- Price change percentage is signed + for positive or zero change.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the instrument type with icon.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the instrument currency.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card does NOT display the OPOL acronym.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card does NOT display the country flag.
- FX_SPOT watchlist card displays the market state indicator (colored dot).
- FX_SPOT watchlist card market state indicator reflects the correct open/closed state based on the instrument schedule.
- Tapping the FX_SPOT watchlist card navigates to the Instrument page.
## 4. Instrument Page
### **General & Header**
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT loads successfully.
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT displays the Simple Chart widget.
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT displays the Instrument Info widget.
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT displays the Portfolio widget.
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT displays the Stats widget.
- Instrument Page for FX_SPOT displays the Transactions widget.
### **Instrument Info Widget**
- For FX_SPOT instruments Instrument Info widget is populated according to design.
>https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1761-107073&t=LLodB9AW7sJZUtP7-4
- Instrument Info widget displays the instrument description.
- Instrument Info widget displays the symbol logo.
>For now we use 2 first letters of the description. Thread: https://devexperts.slack.com/archives/C08C65HS069/p1749718994161279?thread_ts=1749713295.776949&cid=C08C65HS069
- Instrument Info widget displays the instrument symbol.
- Instrument Info widget displays the instrument type label.
- Instrument Info widget displays the instrument currency.
- Instrument Info widget displays the instrument type color logo.
- Instrument Info widget displays the market state indicator (colored dot).
- Instrument Info widget does NOT display the OPOL acronym.
- Instrument Info widget does NOT display the country flag.
- Instrument Info widget market state indicator reflects the correct open/closed state based on the instrument schedule.
- Current price is displayed with correct instrument precision.
- ChangePrevDayClosePrice is correctly displayed.
- ChangePrevDayClosePrice is signed + for positive change.
- ChangePrevDayClosePrice is signed - for negative change.
- ChangePrevDayClosePrice is colour-coded with red for negatives.
- ChangePrevDayClosePrice is colour-coded with green for >= 0.
- ChangePrevDayClosePricePercent is correctly calculated from ChangePrevDayClosePrice.
- ChangePrevDayClosePricePercent is colour-coded with red for negatives.
- ChangePrevDayClosePricePercent is colour-coded with green for >= 0.
- ChangePrevDayClosePricePercent is signed + for positive change.
- ChangePrevDayClosePricePercent is signed - for negative change.
- Instrument Info widget does NOT display trading conditions (swap/interest rates) for FX_SPOT.
### **Portfolio**
>As this section is not explicitly covered by the Epic, we check only superficial presence of these elements.
- Portfolio widget displays the 'Positions' section for FX_SPOT instruments.
- Portfolio widget displays the 'Orders' section for FX_SPOT instruments.
- Portfolio widget displays the standard empty state message for Positions for FX_SPOT instruments when there is no data.
- Portfolio widget displays the standard empty state message for Orders for FX_SPOT instruments when there is no data.
### **Transactions**
>As this section is not explicitly covered by the Epic, we check only superficial presence of these elements.
- Transactions widget displays the standard empty state message for FX_SPOT instruments when there is no data.
- Transactions widget displays the standard column headers for FX_SPOT instruments.
- Transactions widget displays the standard transaction type filter for FX_SPOT instruments.
### **Simple Chart**
- Simple Chart for FX_SPOT is based on the midpoint price.
>TBD on how to confirm; after XT-7054 is developed.
- Simple Chart for FX_SPOT loads data correctly from dxFeed per account group.
- Chart Type control panel does not overlap with the Buy/Sell button on the FX_SPOT Instrument page.
### **Stats Widget**
- Stats widget for FX_SPOT displays the Multiplier field.
>Multiplier value is inherited from IPF (e.g., 100000).
- Stats widget for FX_SPOT displays the Previous Close field.
- Stats widget for FX_SPOT displays the Open field.
- Stats widget for FX_SPOT displays the Day Range field.
- Stats widget for FX_SPOT does NOT display the 'Maturity date' field.
### **Inactive/Hidden Elements**
- Events tab is hidden on the FX_SPOT Instrument page.
- News tab is hidden on the FX_SPOT Instrument page.
